note: Real run on a live site's accounts, anonymised: brand, domain, pages, queries, competitors and ids replaced; numbers rounded to 2 significant figures, so totals may not add up exactly. DataForSEO mention counts, AI search volumes and share-of-voice percentages are rounded to 1 significant figure. The run was made on 2026-10-02 through the InsightfulPipe MCP, and every number in expected_output.json was computed by a script from the raw responses. Third-party domains in AI answers and search results are described by type (vendor site, listing site, platform docs). FAQ answers were drafted from each page's own text and are shown as a summary with their real word count. 8 DataForSEO calls: the 7 the skill makes, plus one ai_opt_llm_mentions_aggregated test call that came back empty, which is why the skill uses cross_aggregated only. The user supplied the priority questions and competitors when asked in step 3 of Before you start; they are not the step 3 defaults (which would have been the top non-brand question queries by impressions and the domains that outrank the site).
